Scopes this directory to ESM. @react-pdf/renderer v4 is ESM-only (@react-pdf/hyphenate declares an "import" condition with no "require"), while the rest of src/ resolves as CJS because the root package.json sets no "type". Without this file, importing the document from any node script fails with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED. next build is green with it.
